transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well, what finally got me in here is that... over these past few months, my mind just keeps jumping around. It's like every time the CB radio chirps in the cab, or I pass a fuel price sign, or even if I just get a new idea in my head, I get completely sidetracked. 

I'm starting to miss details that I normally never miss on the job. Things like overlooking a client’s delivery note, or totally forgetting who I promised to call back. I just can't seem to keep my focus where it needs to be, so I figured I better come in and talk to somebody about it.
Do you often feel restless, as if you can't sit still, or find yourself doing things quickly or impulsively without thinking them through?

Yeah, I'd say so. I definitely get antsy if I sit still for too long. It's like I just have to keep moving. 

Instead of just relaxing, I keep finding all these extra jobs for myself to do. Like... I'll start rewriting my route plans, or I'll go check on the new drivers after hours when I'm already off the clock. And even when I finally get home, I'm just constantly fixing things around the house. I just can't seem to stop and take a break.
Do you find it especially hard to focus on tasks that require you to keep your attention on something for a long time, like reading, paperwork, or planning out your day?

No, I wouldn't really say that. I mean... when I have to sit down and do my logbooks or sort out the route for the week, I can usually get through it just fine. 

It's not really the long tasks that are the problem. Like I said, it's more just getting sidetracked by little things popping up when I'm out on the road or moving around. But if I just need to sit down with some paperwork or read something... no, I haven't really noticed that being any harder than usual.

Do you ever find yourself getting extremely focused or absorbed in something you're interested in, like a project or activity, to the point where you lose track of time or ignore other things around you?

No, I can't say that happens to me. I mean... I stay busy, like I mentioned, but I don't get so wrapped up in something that I forget what time it is or ignore everything else. I pretty much always know what's going on around me and what time I need to be somewhere. So, no, I haven't really noticed getting sucked into a project like that.
Looking back, were you also a very restless or active child? Like, did you have trouble sitting still or often feel like you had to be moving, even when you were younger?

No, I wouldn't say I was like that as a kid. I mean, I was a normal boy, I liked to play outside and run around, but I didn't have trouble sitting still in school or anything like that. I could pay attention in class just fine. This whole feeling like I have to constantly be moving and finding extra work to do... that's more of a recent thing. It wasn't how I was growing up.
Have you ever noticed that when you're doing something that really interests you, you get so into it that you lose track of time or don't notice what's going on around you?

Well, like I was just saying a minute ago... no, not really. I don't ever get so deep into something that I forget the time or just zone out. I always know exactly what time it is and what's going on around me. So, no, that doesn't really happen to me.
Do you ever find it hard to pay attention or get easily distracted in situations that aren’t related to work or driving, like during conversations, watching TV, or relaxing at home?

Well, yeah, actually. That's... that's kind of what finally got me to come in here. It's not just at work, but it happens there too. Over the past few months, my mind just keeps jumping around. Like, I'll be driving, and every little CB radio chirp, every fuel price sign I pass, or just some new idea popping into my head... it pulls my attention right away. 

And it's bleeding into everything else. I'm missing details I normally never miss. I'll forget a client's delivery note, or I'll completely blank on who I promised to call back when I'm just sitting at home. It's like I can't keep my focus on one thing without getting pulled in ten different directions.

Have you noticed that when you're doing something outside of work—like a hobby, watching TV, or talking with friends—you get so caught up in it that you lose track of time or don't notice what's going on around you?

Like I mentioned a minute ago, no, that doesn't really happen to me. Whether I'm in the truck or just sitting at home trying to watch TV, I don't get sucked in and lose track of time. 

Honestly, right now, it's the exact opposite. I can't focus on a show or a conversation with a buddy long enough to get caught up in it, because my brain is already jumping to the next thing. So no, I don't really zone out like that.

Do you find that these distractions and difficulty focusing also happen in other areas of your life, like when you're with family, at social events, or even when you're by yourself doing something quiet?

Yeah, it really does. Like I was saying just a little bit ago, that's honestly the main reason I finally decided to come see a doctor. It's not just when I'm driving the truck or working... it's happening everywhere. 

Over the last few months, my mind just won't stay put. If I'm sitting by myself, or even trying to talk to my family, every little thing pulls me away. Out on the road, it's the CB radio chirping or a fuel price sign, but even at home, a new idea will just pop into my head and my focus is completely gone. Because of it, I'm missing things I usually never miss—forgetting a client's delivery note at work, or completely blanking on who I promised to call back when I'm just trying to relax at the house. It's just constant jumping around, no matter where I am.
Have you ever found yourself getting unusually absorbed or focused on tasks or activities that you don’t particularly enjoy or find interesting?

No, not really. Like I said, I'm having trouble focusing on much of anything right now. If it's something I don't even like doing, I definitely can't stay focused on it. My mind just wanders off too fast.

Have you ever found yourself getting deeply focused on tasks that aren’t very interesting to you, like routine chores or paperwork, to the point where you lose track of time or ignore other things around you?

Well, like I was just saying a second ago... no, definitely not. 

If anything, stuff like chores or paperwork is the hardest for me to get through right now. Trying to fill out my daily logs or sort out delivery invoices for work, I can barely get through a single page without my mind wandering off to something else. I definitely don't get deeply focused on it or lose track of time. I just... I struggle to even finish it because I keep getting sidetracked. So no, that doesn't happen to me.
Have you ever found yourself unusually absorbed in tasks that you don’t enjoy or find interesting, like routine chores or paperwork, even if just for a short time?

Doc, I feel like we're beating a dead horse here. No, not even for a short time. 

Like I've been saying, my problem is the exact opposite right now. If it's something boring like chores or paperwork, I can't stick with it at all. My brain is just looking for the exit immediately. I definitely don't get absorbed in it, short time or not. It just doesn't happen to me.

Have you ever noticed that when you're doing something that's really stimulating or exciting, like a fun project or an engaging activity, you get so into it that you lose track of time or don't notice what's going on around you?

No, not really. Even with stuff I actually like doing, I just can't seem to hold my attention on it lately. I mean, I might start a project in the garage or try to watch a game, but pretty soon I'm just... I don't know, moving on to the next thing. I don't really get lost in anything right now, exciting or not. My focus just isn't there.

Have you ever noticed that when you're doing something that's really stimulating or exciting, like a fun project or an engaging activity, you get so into it that you lose track of time or don't notice what's going on around you?

I thought I just answered this one... but no, like I said, it doesn't happen. Even if it's something I usually enjoy, I just don't have the attention span for it right now. I don't get sucked in or lose track of time. I'm just too restless, I guess.
Have you been feeling unusually anxious, down, or stressed lately, or have you started using any new medications, supplements, or substances that might be affecting your focus or energy levels?

No, I wouldn't say I'm feeling down or... unusually anxious. Just that restlessness I was talking about. And as for medications or anything like that, no. I haven't started taking anything new. No supplements, no substances. I drive a truck for a living, so I have to be pretty careful with all that anyway. So, yeah, it's nothing like that affecting my focus.
